newsitem.title: USA: April Brent mostly up in light U.S. trading late.
newsitem.headline: April Brent mostly up in light U.S. trading late.

text.p: North Sea Brent was mostly higher in light U.S. trading late Wednesday with only a handful of players taking part.
Five partial paper April Brent cargoes traded at between $20.24 and $20.30 a barrel, compared to the IPE settlement of $20.24, traders said.
Two Brents traded 100 times each at $20.30, another two 200 times apiece moved at $20.27 and one traded 85 times at $20.24.
March/April Brent changed hands at 34 cents, up four cents from the London close.
Earlier in the day, March/April spreads traded at 32 and 35 cents a barrel.
